title: Library study room booking — one-page product note

facts.text: There are fourteen group study rooms in the library
A booking lasts up to two hours
A booking requires a college email address
Students can book up to 30 days in advance
A student cannot hold more than two active bookings
The room list can be filtered by equipment such as a projector
Cancelling a booking frees the slot immediately
Library staff can block a room for maintenance and affected bookings are cancelled
